title: Honeyhives
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Generic |image = Bee Nest.png }} '''Honeyhives''' are structures in the {{Zone|Torrhus Canyon}}. They are the primary source of {{Item|Honeycomb}}. == Overview == '''Honeyhives''' are found all across the {{Zone|Torrhus Canyon}}. They can be interacted with to obtain {{Item|Honeycomb}}. Additionally, the player has a chance to obtain {{Item|Enchanted Honeycomb}}, {{Coins}}, and a random bee-related [[Shard]]. The {{Item|Honeybuzz Shard}}'s {{Attr|Honey Haul}} attribute grants a chance to double the amount of {{Item|Honeycomb}} obtained. A {{MobSprite|Honeybuzz}} has a {{Chance|50%|1|2}} chance to spawn upon looting a '''Honeyhive'''. This yields the following message: {{Dialogue|&f&oA &7&oHoneybuzz &f&oappeared, angry at you for stealing its honey!}} Looting a '''Honeyhive''' yields the following message: {{Dialogue|&7&oYou stick your hand into the honeyhive and feel around.../&6&lHIVE! &fYou found Honeycome &8x# &7and &8&f!}} Looting a '''Honeyhive''' causes it to go on cooldown for {{Green|60m}}. The {{Item|Queen Bee Shard}}'s {{Attr|Honey Refill}} [[Attribute]] grants a chance to instantly refill the '''Honeyhive'''. === Possible Loot === '''Honeyhives''' are guaranteed to drop {{Item|Honeycomb|amount=16-64}}s and another item from the pool: {| class="wikitable ct" !
